changeSet.author: petstore
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE category ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, code TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_category PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_category_code UNIQUE (code) );

changeSet.author: petstore
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE species ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, code TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_species PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_species_code UNIQUE (code) );

changeSet.author: petstore
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE brand ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, code TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_brand PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_brand_code UNIQUE (code) );

changeSet.author: petstore
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE product ( id UUID NOT NULL, sku TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, price DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL, active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, category_id BIGINT NOT NULL, species_id BIGINT NOT NULL, brand_id BIGINT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_product PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_product_sku UNIQUE (sku), CONSTRAINT fk_product_category FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES category (id), CONSTRAINT fk_product_species FOREIGN KEY (species_id) REFERENCES species (id), CONSTRAINT fk_product_brand FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brand (id) );
